reason: The logic holds and it costs nothing, but it is narrower and less new than claimed. (1) Mechanism is correct. uptest.py counts TeamIds ranked above us at S0 and below us at S1. Public bests never fall, and the LB orders teams inside a 3-decimal block by unrounded score (CONTEXT l.1849; the _lb/S1_0934Z CSV has distinct ranks inside the 0.957 block). So an UP at an equal 0.957 display does mean the new file's unrounded score is above our previous best. An exact tie goes to the earlier submission and shows no UP, which is the conservative direction. (2) It is not a new hypothesis. It is the existing U<B> code of the 28 SEP READ TABLE v2 (27 Sep 18:50Z: '= B with an UP -> U<B>') and of the v3 cap-6 codes ('0.956 with an UP -> +'). R25S-2 already defines '0u' in scan_hyp_sched29.json. This finding only restates it for the new 0.957 best. (3) Probe 50: W2b amendment A already codes any display >= 0.957 as R+, so 0u changes no branch. It only orders exp85a against exp79a on the finals card: a public gap below 0.001 on one embryo (29%), with ~0 private signal, and the user picks the finals. So it is info-only, not the 'finals BEST' decider. (4) Probe 51: this is the real effect. Under R+, a 0.957 read with UP switches BEST_CI from NONE to exp87a. That is sound: the UP means exp87a is above max(exp79a, exp85a) whenever exp85a displays 0.957, and if exp85a displays 0.958 a 0u is impossible. The one-completion condition holds naturally, because 51 is our only pending file from ~12:45Z until the 00:05Z night subs, which cannot complete before ~07:00Z. (5) 'Resolves a third' is a guess, not a measurement. At 09:34Z we were 16th of 42 in the 0.957 block (15 above), so P(a 0.957 lands above exp79a) is ~0.37 under a uniform prior. The remaining 0.957 reads stay '0', which is not proof of non-additivity either. (6) R+ arms: the 00:05Z and 00:25Z arms share the 7.0-7.8 h latency band and can complete inside one snapshot window. That gives a +2 step and MASKED, so 0u is often unavailable for them. It also needs a snapshot between their completions (poller < 10 min). (7) Feasibility risk: uptest.py lives only in a temp session scratchpad (AppData/Local/Temp/claude/.../scratchpad/uptest.py), not in the repo. A night or morning session may not have it.
fix: Log one pre-score line before 56629533 (probe 50) is terminal (~12:05Z). It restates the existing U-code as '0u' for the 0.957 best: 0.957 display + attributable UP (uptest compare, S1 count = S0 count + 1, k >= 1 in our block) = '0u'; a +2 step or k = 0 = '?'. Apply it: (a) probe 51: '0u' is handled as '+' for the BEST_CI choice only, as in R25S-2; (b) probe 50: '0u' is info for the finals card only (exp85a unrounded above exp79a, public-only, single embryo); it changes no R code and does not pick the finals; (c) night arms: '0u' only on a clean one-completion step, otherwise MASKED. Drop the 'resolves a third' claim, or quote it as a ~0.37 uniform-prior guess. Copy uptest.py from the session scratchpad into tools/uptest.py, keep the S0/S1 zips under experiments/lb_poll/_lb/, and log the S0/S1 names, counts, k and TeamIds passed at each read.
realistic_gain: Public: it changes one decision, BEST_CI under R+ when probe 51 reads 0.957 with UP (~0.35 of such reads). That feeds at most one morning M1 file with P(new best) ~0.2. So E[public display] is ~+0.0001, and it moves rank inside the 0.957/0.958 blocks. Private: ~0, because a sub-rounding public gap on one embryo is not a private signal. Runtime and build cost: 0.
